items.raw_excerpt: A drop-off in foot traffic in Adelaide's CBD prompts an exchange between the state's Property Council and the city council, which are at odds on parking and residential development.
items.summary_en: Fewer people are walking through Adelaide's city centre, according to new council data. The state's property group and the city council are blaming each other over parking and new housing growth in the area.
items.summary_ko: 새 council 자료를 보면 애들레이드 시내 중심을 걷는 사람이 줄었다는 사실이 드러났다. 주 부동산 단체와 시청은 주차 문제와 새 아파트 개발을 두고 서로 책임을 넘기며 다툰다.
items.title_en: Adelaide city centre foot traffic drops, councils point fingers
items.title_ko: 애들레이드 CBD 보행자 급감, 시 조례의회와 시청 서로 밀어냄
items.title_original: 'Sophistication' spat over foot traffic decline in Adelaide CBD

items.raw_excerpt: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has promised to quickly find a new team to operate and reopen two childen's museums being forced to close next week by financial red tape.
items.summary_en: Bangkok City Hall says it will quickly find a new team to run two children's museums. Money rule problems were set to close both places next week. The city wants children to keep visiting them.
items.summary_ko: 방콕 시청은 어린이박물관 두 곳에 새 운영팀을 빨리 찾아 다시 문을 열겠다고 약속했다. 자금 관련 규정 때문에 다음 주에 문을 닫을 예정이었다. 시청은 아이들이 계속 관람할 수 있도록 quickly 해결하겠다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Bangkok City Hall Promises to Reopen Two Children's Museums
items.title_ko: 방콕 시청, 어린이박물관 두 곳 조속히 재개방
items.title_original: City Hall pledges quick reopening of two children's museums

items.raw_excerpt: Kiria Tikanah's silver medal is the best result by a Singapore fencer at the Asian Games.
items.summary_en: Kiria Tikanah won a silver medal in epee at the Asian Games. It is the best result ever by a Singapore fencer at the Games. She also became the first Singapore fencer to reach an Asian Games final.
items.summary_ko: 키리아 티카나가 아시안게임 에페 종목에서 은메달을 땄습니다. 이는 싱가포르 펜서가 아시안게임에서 거둔 최고 기록입니다. 그녀는 또한 아시안게임 결승에 오른 최초의 싱가포르 펜서가 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Singapore's Kiria Tikanah Wins Epee Silver at the Asian Games

items.title_original: Singapore's Kiria Tikanah clinches epee silver at Asian Games, makes history

items.raw_excerpt: Clear skies and crisp fall air made for the perfect backdrop as the Village of Weston kicked off its first Weston Village Fair & Jubilee...
items.summary_en: The Vermont Country Store is 80 years old this year. To mark the day, the Village of Weston held its first Weston Village Fair and Jubilee. Clear skies and cool fall air made a good day for the local fair.

items.raw_excerpt: Chef and TikTok star Poppy O’Toole talks about online haters and how her approach to food has changed since becoming a mum.
items.summary_en: Chef Poppy O'Toole says male chefs doing the same work as her get far less online hate. The TikTok star also says becoming a mum changed the way she cooks and thinks about food.

items.title_en: Poppy O'Toole Says Male Chefs Get Less Online Hate

items.raw_excerpt: Uma árvore de grande porte caiu e bloqueou parte do trânsito na Rua Conselheiro Laurindo, no bairro Prado Velho, em Curitiba, na manhã desta terça-feira
items.summary_en: A large tree fell on a busy street in Curitiba on Tuesday morning. The storm brought the tree down and it blocked two lanes. Drivers had to take another way around it.

items.raw_excerpt: Founded by Mr Tan Khung Ngee and his wife, Madam Tan Hong Keow, in 1971, the family business later passed to their son who had initially hoped to pursue medicine.
items.summary_en: Mr Tan Khung Ngee and his wife Madam Tan Hong Keow started Tollyjoy in 1971 with about 100 workers. Their son took over the business, even though he first hoped to become a doctor. Today the family brand sells baby care products across the region.
items.summary_ko: 탄 쿵응이와 부인 탄 홍커우 부부가 1971년 약 100명 규모의 공장에서 톨리조이를 시작했다. 아들은 의사가 되고 싶어했지만 결국 부모의 가업을 이어받았다. 오늘날 이 가족 브랜드는 동남아 여러 나라에서 아기용품을 판매한다.
items.title_en: How a Singapore baby brand grew from a 100-worker factory to a regional name in 55 years

items.summary_en: The chief minister of Tamil Nadu looked at plans to restore the Cooum river in Chennai. He read a detailed project report and growth plans for the area.

items.raw_excerpt: Spain’s public broadcaster RTVE has released never-before-seen footage of foreign hippies in Ibiza in the early 70s, a film reel censored by Franco’s dictatorship and which showcases how much Spanish society has changed.
items.summary_en: Spain's public broadcaster RTVE has released a film reel that Franco's dictatorship had banned. The film shows foreign hippie life on Ibiza in the early 1970s. Watching it today shows how much Spanish society has changed.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 국영방송(RTVE)이 프랑코 정권이 상영을 금지했던 영화 필름을 공개했다. 이 필름에는 1970년대 초 이비자에 머물던 외국 히피들의 모습이 담겨 있다. 지금 보면 스페인 사회가 얼마나 많이 달라졌는지-eye가 들어나게 느껴진다.
items.title_en: Spain shares censored 1970s Ibiza hippie film
items.title_ko: 스페인, 억압됐던 1970년대 이비자 히피 영화 공개
items.title_original: Spain releases censored Franco-era footage of foreign hippies in Ibiza

items.raw_excerpt: Moving to the Netherlands means picking not just a country but also a city, and in 2026 that choice matters more than it used to. Rents in the unregulated sector rose 7.3% nationally over the past year, according to the latest Pararius Huurmonitor, pushing the average to roughly €21 per square metre. But that average hides a lot of variation. Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, The Hague, and Eindhoven, the so-called G5, each behave quite differently right now, and the gap between...
items.summary_en: Rents in the Netherlands rose 7.3 percent in one year to about 21 euros per square meter. Big cities like Amsterdam and Rotterdam each have their own price level, so your city choice matters a lot for your budget.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 임대료는 1년 사이 7.3% 올라.square m당 약 21유로가 됐다. 암스테르담과 로테르담 등 대도시는 가격대가 각각 달라, 어떤 도시에 사느냐가 가계에 큰 영향을 준다.
items.title_en: Which Dutch city fits your budget in 2026
items.title_original: Which Dutch city actually fits your budget and lifestyle in 2026

items.raw_excerpt: At the end of 2025, Portugal had a total of 1,585,854 foreign citizens residing in the country, 38,000 more than the previous year, announced the Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum (AIMA).
items.summary_en: Portugal had 1,585,854 foreign residents at the end of 2025. That is about 38,000 more than one year earlier. The Agency for Integration, Migration and Asylum reported the number.

items.raw_excerpt: Prolonged rain sent strong water down steep streets in eastern Ho Chi Minh City on Tuesday evening, while traffic backed up on many central roads.
items.summary_en: Long rain sent water rushing down steep streets in eastern Ho Chi Minh City on Tuesday evening. Cars crawled on many roads in the city center as water piled up.
